paragraphs: Avimi of Chavraya, a visitor to the sick [מבקר בישא; the compared midrash reads מבקר בישיא]. Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba spoke to him (Bereshit Rabbah, section 13). Mattenot Kehunah explains Chavraya as a place name in the name of Tosafot, first chapter of Chullin. (See Rabbi Oshaya the younger of Chavraya.)
